verdicts.reason: A shrinks the featured YEARLY card so it's smaller than MONTHLY and FAMILY, which reverses the original emphasis on that card. Its subhead is set almost as large as the cards and squeezed into a narrow six-line column ('and' sits alone on a line), so it competes with the prices. The headline is oversized and the fine print is illegible. B keeps all three cards the same size, as in the original, and the subhead is quieter. B's flaws: the subhead still wraps awkwardly in a cramped left column, the cards nearly touch it, the logo floats disconnected from the right-set headline, and the legal text under the CTA is far too small to read.
